scope: Extend the prespecified fixed-read deletion experiment to the remaining difficult sequences 8 and 20 without tuning from their labels. Use the same existing raw-window video references and prompts; no additional detector calls or altered propagation.
selection: Use the last four of the five post-initial targets already frozen in lean_channel_attention_training_pilot_v1 split preflight: seq8 frames 19,37,54,72 and seq20 frames 23,32,42,51. The earliest target is excluded because it does not allow enough history for the 1024-token intervention. These sequences were previously inspected and results are exploratory.
design: Same author model, score reconstruction alignment test, 1024-token matched deletion arms, fixed no-op replay and two-process repeat checks as lean_channel_fixed_read_v1. Capture the raw-window trajectory with a read-only observer and require masks, memory trace, and metadata to match archived raw-window references. Score labels only after all replay outputs for each sequence are fixed. No full-video modified candidate is implied by the observer replay.
controls: Usage, unweighted contrast, distributed, RGB, shuffled, three-region, foreground, prompt-conditioned CBAM, descriptor-independent CBAM and mismatched-descriptor CBAM. Report exact token-selection overlaps and per-frame metrics, plus empty false alarms. The highest ranked tokens are removed to measure sensitivity, not retained as a proposed memory bank.
